name: Concurrent Separation Logic Constraint (O'Hearn)
description: cvc5 SMT verification of resource disjointness in concurrent programs

pytorch.reason: pytorch not needed; pure symbolic/algebraic computation via cvc5 and sympy

pyg.reason: PyG message passing not needed; logic constraints handled via SMT solver

z3.reason: z3 not needed; cvc5 handles all SMT constraint proofs in this sim

cvc5.reason: load_bearing SMT verification of concurrent resource disjointness

sympy.reason: sympy: supportive symbolic algebra for separation logic formulas

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra not needed; concurrent logic constraints only

geomstats.reason: geomstats not needed; no differential geometry in this sim

e3nn.reason: e3nn not needed; no SO(3) equivariance required

rustworkx.reason: rustworkx not needed; no graph structure in this sim

xgi.reason: xgi not needed; pairwise interactions only

toponetx.reason: toponetx not needed; standard algebraic ops sufficient

gudhi.reason: gudhi not needed; no persistent homology in this sim
